<title level="1" right="Creature Family">[Unicorn](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=504)</title>

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 190

While the most commonly known unicorn is a silver horse with a single horn, a wide variety of these creatures exist, some rarer than others.

<title level="2">Members</title>
[Alicorn](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3320) (Creature 15), [Karkadann](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3318) (Creature 7), [Pale Horse](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3319) (Creature 11), [Unicorn](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3223) (Creature 3)
